UPSSSC BCG Technician Final Answer Key 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released the final answer key for the recruitment of BCG Technician posts on the official website of UPSSSC. This recruitment was released for 255 posts. Applications for the UPSSSC BCG Technician Recruitment 2024 were accepted from 08 July 2024, to 07 August 2024. The written examination was conducted on 30 June 2026. Candidates who had appeared in this examination can download their UPSSSC BCG Technician Final Answer Key 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start : 08 July 2024
  • Last Date for Apply : 07 August 2024
  • Last Date Fee Payment : 07 August 2024
  • Correction Last Date : 14 August 2024
  • Eligibility Result : 08 June 2026
  • Exam Date : 30 June 2026
  • Exam City Details : 22 June 2026
  • Admit Card Available : 25 June 2026
  • Answer Key : 01 July 2026
  • Final Answer Key : 20 August 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 25/-
  • SC, ST, Candidates : Rs. 25/-
  • PH Candidates : Rs. 25/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
